Name: No Loading Screens
Author: xzqute
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/SaRllze.png[/img][/center]
[center][url=https://smapi.io][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI-4.5.0+-brightgreen.svg[/img][/url] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Stardew%20Valley-1.6+-orange.svg[/img] [/center]
[center][size=4]No more staring at a black screen every time you walk through a door. Sprites for the next area load before the game switches you over.[/size]
 [/center]
[center] [/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/X1Ez0rq.gif[/img][/center]
[center] [/center]
[heading][size=5]What it does[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Supported location changes skip the fade-to-black entirely.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]The destination map's sprites get pulled in before you arrive, so there's nothing to pop in.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Vanilla still handles the warp itself - this mod just hides the loading screen around it.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Installation[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Get [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.0 or newer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download No Loading Screens.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Drop the [i]NoLoadingScreens[/i] folder into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i].[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Launch through SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Made and tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 with SMAPI 4.5.0+.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Covers standard single-player transitions - that's the main thing it's been checked against.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]If a transition isn't recognized as safe, it just plays out the normal vanilla way.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]No touching maps, warps, gameplay, or saves.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Worth knowing[/size][/heading]
[size=4]Nothing here stitches maps together or renders one area next to another, and the camera doesn't do anything fancy either. All that's actually gone is the black screen.[/size]
